title: Kaneki Harness — Ticket Lifecycle Flow (v0.1.0)
description: How one ticket moves through graph/lifecycle.json: analysis for bug or feature, implementation with staged review, verification and delivery, shipping and the after-PR review round, plus the lite lane for small changes.

lanes.label: Lite lane · small change · in place

nodes.label: prepare
nodes.detail: Unit worker · tier light · gate G7. Fetches the ticket through the tracker adapter, resolves repos / stacks / surfaces from the profile, creates the worktree, runs the environment doctor. Artifacts: ticket.md, environment.md.

nodes.label: requirement
nodes.detail: requirement-analysis (feature only) · worker routine + reviewer deep · gate G1. Reads every requirement source, lists conflicts and gaps, resolves them with the user before design.

nodes.label: impact
nodes.detail: impact-analysis (feature only) · worker routine. Maps every caller, data flow, surface and shared resource the change touches.

nodes.label: feature-plan
nodes.detail: feature-plan · user boundary · worker routine · gate G3 · rulePhases design. Design and task plan the user approves; produces approved-plan + review-scope.

nodes.label: investigate
nodes.detail: investigate (bug only) · worker deep · gates G1, G7. Reproduces the defect and proves the root cause with executed evidence; investigation.md must have ## Confirmed cause and a confidence.

nodes.label: fix-plan
nodes.detail: fix-plan · user boundary · worker deep · gate G3 · rulePhases design. Smallest fix that removes the proven cause; every changed condition gets a negative case.

nodes.label: coding
nodes.detail: coding · worker light, escalates to routine after 2 failed code-review rounds · gates G6, G7 · rulePhases code. Implements the approved plan in the ticket worktree and self-checks code-phase rules.

nodes.label: code-review
nodes.detail: code-review · staged units: technical-review (routine: build, lint, test, run app, code rules), then semantic-review (deep: plan conformance, negative cases) only after technical PASS · gate G4 · loopBackTo coding. A fix round reviews only the fix.

nodes.label: @slot
nodes.detail: @slot:after-code-review — extension point for project families (e.g. examples/wms/extensions/if-family.json). Empty unless the profile enables a family.

nodes.label: testcase
nodes.detail: testcase · worker routine · gate G5 · rulePhases test. Derives test cases from the approved plan (not from the code) in the profile's testcase format.

nodes.label: testcase-review
nodes.detail: testcase-review · worker routine · gates G4, G5 · loopBackTo testcase. Checks coverage of every plan condition and expected value.

nodes.label: execute-evidence
nodes.detail: execute-and-evidence · worker routine + reviewer routine · gates G6, G7 · rulePhases evidence. Runs every in-scope case on its real surface through the surface adapter, captures before / after state, audits the evidence.

nodes.label: @slot
nodes.detail: @slot:after-evidence — extension point for project families (extra verification). Empty unless the profile enables a family.

nodes.label: final-review
nodes.detail: final-review · worker routine · gate G5 · rulePhases design, code, test, evidence, delivery. Reuses verdicts already PASS at code-review; the controller issues one receipt per repository.

nodes.label: delivery-drafts
nodes.detail: delivery-drafts · worker light · rulePhases delivery. Writes the drafts the delivery adapter lists: commit message, PR body, tracker reply.

nodes.label: deliverable-ready
nodes.detail: deliverable-ready · user boundary · no dispatch · gate G7 · checksReceipts. Receipts must still be valid and match the checkouts; the user approves the drafts.

nodes.label: kaneki-ship
nodes.detail: Outside the graph: sdlc ship-request (receipts + commit message CM003–CM016 → requestDigest) → user approves that digest → sdlc ship (lease in .sdlc/ship-approvals.json; native-git or my-git) → sdlc ship-record verifies the commit / PR.

nodes.label: read-review
nodes.detail: read-review (review round) · worker routine · gate G7. Started by sdlc review-fetch or sdlc handback; loads the full review thread and drops comments on an older head.

nodes.label: triage-review
nodes.detail: triage-review · user boundary · worker deep + reviewer deep · gate G3 · reopens. Verifies every claim, decides per comment, names the earliest invalidated node: sdlc gate … --reopen <node> or --reopen none.

nodes.label: Rerun stale
nodes.detail: sdlc invalidate stales the reopened node and only downstream consumers of its tokens; they rerun through the main graph. Reopened artifacts carry ## SUPERSEDED: lines and only the text below the last marker counts at gate time.

nodes.label: respond-review
nodes.detail: respond-review · user boundary · worker routine. One reply per review comment with the fix evidence or the reason for rejection; the delivery adapter re-ships with user approval.

nodes.label: scope
nodes.detail: scope (lite) · user boundary · no dispatch · gates G1, G3, G7. The controller reads the request and code, writes what changes, which files, done-when, and why it is small; one approval question.

nodes.label: change
nodes.detail: change (lite) · done by the controller, no dispatch · gates G6, G7. Edits the scoped files in place on the ticket branch (no worktree) and runs format / lint / build.

nodes.label: check
nodes.detail: check (lite) · unit quick-review routine · gates G4, G7 · loopBackTo change. Reads the real diff against scope and code rules, reruns checks; closing issues the receipts kaneki-ship needs.

nodes.label: delivery-drafts
nodes.detail: delivery-drafts in the lite lane is in the inline list: the controller writes the drafts itself, no subagent.

nodes.label: deliverable-ready
nodes.detail: deliverable-ready (lite) · user boundary · then the same kaneki-ship and after-PR round (read-review inline) as the full lane.

legend.label: Only when a family fills the slot

cards.title: Analysis · prepare → approved plan
items: prepare — light tier, G7: tracker fetch, repos / stacks / surfaces from the profile, worktree, environment doctor
Feature: requirement-analysis (routine + deep reviewer, G1) → impact-analysis (routine) → feature-plan (routine, you approve, G3)
Bug: investigate (deep, G1 · G7, proven root cause with confidence) → fix-plan (deep, you approve, G3)
G1 stops coding until analysis doubts are settled with ASK_USER; G3 asks you when options differ materially or a shared flow changes

cards.title: Implementation · staged review
items: coding — light tier in the worktree; escalates to routine after 2 failed code-review rounds (escalateAfter)
code-review — technical-review (routine) first; semantic-review (deep) only after its PASS; either FAIL reopens coding
Loop cap — NEEDS CHANGES past profile gates.loopCap (default 2) stops at G4 for your decision
testcase → testcase-review (routine, G5): cases come from the plan, not the code; @slot:after-code-review hosts family nodes

cards.title: Verification and delivery · receipts
items: execute-and-evidence — every in-scope case on its real surface via the surface adapter; G6 for shared state or real devices
final-review — the full rulepack across all phases, reusing earlier PASS verdicts; one receipt per repository
delivery-drafts → deliverable-ready — drafts from the delivery adapter; you approve; receipts must still match the checkouts (G7)
kaneki-ship — ship-request → you approve the requestDigest → ship (native-git or my-git) → ship-record

cards.title: After PR and the lite lane
items: After PR — sdlc review-fetch / handback → read-review → triage-review (deep, you decide, --reopen X) → only invalidated nodes rerun → respond-review → re-ship
Reopened artifacts carry ## SUPERSEDED: lines; only text below the last marker counts at gate time
Lite lane — scope (you approve) → change in place → check (one routine reviewer, issues receipts) → drafts inline → deliverable-ready; no worktree, test cases, evidence or deep tier
Promote with sdlc lane --ticket T --set full --reason …; lite and full share the same ship and after-PR round
